LanguageData.CVG_Convergence_LetterText:
The sky tears open. For a moment, a second sky shows through the rift: floating mountains, rivers of light, palaces among the clouds. A fragment of Jiuxiao, the Realm of the Nine Heavens, has collided with this world.
A wind that is not wind sweeps the land. The air feels thick, alive. Qi, the energy that slept here for ages, begins to flow.
The Era of Cultivation has begun.

LanguageData.CVG_GuideLetterText:
An old saying of Jiuxiao: the Dao is not far from people; people walk away from the Dao. Here is where to find it.

- SPIRIT ROOT: select a colonist and open the CULTIVATION tab. It shows root, realm, stage, qi and what the realm grants. Only colonists with an awakened root can gather qi; the others can temper the body.
- CULTIVATING: build a cultivation spot or cushion (Cultivation build menu) and enable the CULTIVATE job in the Work tab (priority 1 or 2, or nobody will have time for it). Qi concentration and the root speed it up.
- RESEARCH: cultivation research is done at the contemplation desk (Production tab) and lives in the Cultivation tab of the research tree. Reading jade slips needs "technique manuals"; the Foundation realm needs its own research. - TECHNIQUES: the TECHNIQUES command on the colonist, or the button at the top of the Cultivation tab. Spend comprehension points there and put abilities in a combat set.
- BREAKTHROUGH: at the last stage of a realm the BREAKTHROUGH command appears. Great realms bring a heavenly tribulation.
- QI NETWORK: generators, conduits and formations work like power. The qi overlay (map buttons, bottom right) shows where qi gathers.

The Learning Helper explains each step when it comes up.
